readings.title: Not to Us, but to Your Name
readings.subtitle: The absolute sovereignty of the singular Creator in the heavens.
readings.text: [Psalm 115:1] Not to us, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, not to us, But to <dn>Your</dn> Name give esteem, For <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, For <dn>Your</dn> truth. [2] Why should the nations say, “Where now is their <dn>Elohim</dn>?” [3] But our <dn>Elohim</dn> is in the heavens; Whatever pleased <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> has done.

readings.title: The Dead Architecture of Idolatry
readings.subtitle: The impotence of human constructs compared to the Living Elohim.
readings.text: [4] Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands. [5] They have mouths, but they do not speak; They have eyes, but they do not see; [6] They have ears, but they do not hear; They have noses, but they do not smell; [7] They have hands, but they do not handle; They have feet, but they do not walk; They make no sound through their throat. [8] The ones who make them, shall become like them – All who trust in them.

readings.title: The Functional Trust of Yisra’ěl
readings.subtitle: Leaning entirely on the structurally sound promise of YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 115:9] O Yisra’ěl, trust in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; <dn>He</dn> is their help and their shield. [10] O house of Aharon, trust in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; <dn>He</dn> is their help and their shield. [11] You who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, trust in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; <dn>He</dn> is their help and their shield. [12] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has remembered us; <dn>He</dn> blesses us; <dn>He</dn> blesses the house of Yisra’ěl; <dn>He</dn> blesses the house of Aharon. [13] <dn>He</dn> blesses those who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, The small and the great.

readings.title: The Blessing of Endless Increase
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH grants dominion of the earth to adam-kind while establishing His eternal praise.
readings.text: [14] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gives you increase more and more, You and your children. [15] You are blessed by <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Who made the heavens and earth. [16] The heavens are the heavens of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; But <dn>He</dn> has given the earth to the children of men. [17] The dead do not praise <dn>Yah</dn>, Nor any going down to silence. [18] But we, we bless <dn>Yah</dn> Now and forever. Praise <dn>Yah</dn>!

readings.subsection: Saved from the Cords of Death
readings.title: Severing the Cords of Death
readings.subtitle: A cry from the crucible of affliction to the Name of YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 116:1] <dn>I</dn> love <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, because <dn>He</dn> has heard <dn>my</dn> voice, <dn>my</dn> pleas. [2] Because <dn>He</dn> has inclined <dn>His</dn> ear to me, And <dn>I</dn> shall call throughout <dn>my</dn> days. [3] The cords of death were around me, And the pains of She’ol came upon me; <dn>I</dn> found distress and sorrow. [4] Then <dn>I</dn> called upon the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> pray to <dn>You</dn>, deliver <dn>my</dn> being!”

readings.subsection: Saved from the Cords of Death
readings.title: The Compassionate Judge
readings.subtitle: Premial justice applied: deliverance from tears and falling.
readings.text: [5] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shows favour and is righteous; And our <dn>Elohim</dn> is compassionate. [6] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> guards the simple; <dn>I</dn> was brought low, but <dn>He</dn> saved me. [7] Return to your rest, O <dn>my</dn> being, For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has treated you well. [8] For <dn>You</dn> have delivered <dn>my</dn> being from death, <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> eyes from tears, <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> feet from falling. [9] <dn>I</dn> shall walk before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the land of the living.

readings.title: The Cup of Deliverance
readings.subtitle: Returning bounties to the Creator through public declaration.
readings.text: [Psalm 116:10] <dn>I</dn> have believed, for <dn>I</dn> speak; <dn>I</dn> have been greatly afflicted. [11] <dn>I</dn> said in <dn>my</dn> haste, “All men are liars.” [12] What shall <dn>I</dn> return to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? All <dn>His</dn> bounties are upon me. [13] <dn>I</dn> lift up the cup of deliverance, And call upon the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [14] <dn>I</dn> pay <dn>my</dn> vows to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Now in the presence of all <dn>His</dn> people.

readings.title: The Acceptable Thanksgiving
readings.subtitle: The precious weight of a servant's devotion in the courts of YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [15] Precious in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Is the death of <dn>His</dn> lovingly-committed ones. [16] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> am truly <dn>Your</dn> servant, <dn>I</dn> am <dn>Your</dn> servant, the son of <dn>Your</dn> female servant; <dn>You</dn> have loosed <dn>my</dn> bonds. [17] <dn>I</dn> slaughter <dn>You</dn> a slaughtering of thanksgiving, And call upon the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [18] <dn>I</dn> pay <dn>my</dn> vows to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> In the presence of all <dn>His</dn> people, [19] In the courts of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, In your midst, O Yerushalayim. Praise <dn>Yah</dn>!

readings.title: The Universal Call to the Nations
readings.subtitle: The mighty, restorative truth of YeHoVaH is an everlasting structure.
readings.text: [Psalm 117:1] Praise <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all you nations! Extol <dn>Him</dn>, all you peoples! [2] For <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is mighty over us, And the truth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is everlasting. Praise <dn>Yah</dn>!

readings.title: The Unending Cycle of Commitment
readings.subtitle: A national declaration of His immutable framework.
readings.text: [Psalm 118:1] Oh, give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for <dn>He</dn> is good! Because <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting. [2] Let Yisra’ěl now say, “<dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting.” [3] Let the house of Aharon now say, “<dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting.” [4] Let those who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> now say, “<dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting.”

readings.title: The Shelter of Yah
readings.subtitle: Rejecting the systems of man to find a broad place in YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [5] <dn>I</dn> called on <dn>Yah</dn> in distress; <dn>Yah</dn> answered me in a broad place. [6] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is on <dn>my</dn> side; <dn>I</dn> do not fear what man does to me! [7] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is for me among those helping me; Therefore <dn>I</dn> look on those hating me. [8] It is better to take refuge in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Than to trust in man. [9] It is better to take refuge in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Than to trust in princes.

readings.subsection: Victory in the Name of YeHoVaH
readings.title: Extinguishing the Adversarial Nations
readings.subtitle: Victory over surrounding systems engineered by the Name of YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 118:10] All the nations surrounded me, In the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>I</dn> shall cut them off. [11] They surrounded me, Yes, they surrounded me; In the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall <dn>I</dn> cut them off. [12] They surrounded me like bees; They were extinguished like burning thorns; In the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>I</dn> shall cut them off. [13] Pushing, the enemy pushed me to fall, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> helped me. [14] <dn>Yah</dn> is <dn>my</dn> strength and song, And <dn>He</dn> has become <dn>my</dn> deliverance.

readings.subsection: Victory in the Name of YeHoVaH
readings.title: The Exalted Right Hand
readings.subtitle: The active, opposable agent of YeHoVaH executes mighty deliverance.
readings.text: [15] The voice of rejoicing and deliverance Is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is doing mightily. [16] The right hand of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is exalted, The right hand of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> acts mightily. [17] Let me not die, but live, And declare the works of <dn>Yah</dn>. [18] <dn>Yah</dn> has punished me severely, But did not give me over to death.

readings.title: The Geometric Anchor
readings.subtitle: The rejected element becomes the chief corner-stone of the new architecture.
readings.text: [Psalm 118:19] Open to me the gates of righteousness; <dn>I</dn> enter through them, <dn>I</dn> thank <dn>Yah</dn>. [20] This is the gate of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, The righteous enter through it. [21] <dn>I</dn> thank <dn>You</dn>, For <dn>You</dn> have answered me, And have become <dn>my</dn> deliverance. [22] The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief corner-stone. [23] This was from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, It is marvellous in our eyes. [24] This is the day <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has made, Let us rejoice and be glad in it.

readings.title: The Festival of Light
readings.subtitle: Binding the offering to the slaughter-place of the singular Elohim.
readings.text: [25] <dn>I</dn> pray, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, please save us now; <dn>I</dn> pray, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, please send prosperity. [26] Blessed is <dn>He</dn> who is coming in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! We shall bless you from the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [27] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is <dn>Ěl</dn>, and <dn>He</dn> gave us light; Bind the festival offering With cords to the horns of the slaughter-place. [28] <dn>You</dn> are <dn>my</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn>, and <dn>I</dn> praise <dn>You</dn>; <dn>You</dn> are <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>I</dn> exalt <dn>You</dn>. [29] Give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for <dn>He</dn> is good! For <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting.
